meta.name: add-gcal-tool
meta.description: Add Google Calendar as an MCP tool (list calendars, list/search/create events, free/busy queries) using OneCLI-managed OAuth. Multi-calendar and multi-account supported. Mirrors /add-gmail-tool's stub pattern — no raw credentials ever reach the container; OneCLI injects real tokens at request time.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把谷歌日历变成可调用的工具，自动管理日程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在工作流中直接操作谷歌日历
copy.tagline_en: Turn Google Calendar into a callable tool to manage schedules automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to operate Google Calendar directly in your workflow

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以读取和操作你的谷歌日历：列出日历、查看/搜索/创建日程事件，并查询空闲/忙碌时段。支持多个日历和多个账户。你的账号密钥不会进容器，由 OneCLI 在请求时注入。
howto.when: 当你提到“日历”“日程”等词，或要求列出日历、创建事件、查询空闲时段时，Claude 会调用日历工具。

say.text: 我这个周五有什么安排？
say.note: Claude 会搜索或列出那天的日程事件。

say.text: 帮我在明天下午两点创建一场会议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read and operate your Google Calendar: list calendars, view/search/create events, and query free/busy time. Supports multiple calendars and accounts. Your credentials never enter the container; OneCLI injects them at request time.
howto.when_en: When you mention 'calendar'/'schedule' or ask to list calendars, create events, or check availability, Claude calls the calendar tools.

say_en.text: What's on my calendar this Friday?
say_en.note: Claude searches events for that day.

say_en.text: Create a meeting for me at 2pm tomorrow.
